---
title: "Conventions"
---

## Code

- PEP 8, line length 100, checked by `ruff` (`ruff check src tests`); type hints checked by
  `mypy src`.
- Everything in English: identifiers, comments, docstrings, messages, documentation.
- Public functions, classes and methods have NumPy-style docstrings: description, Parameters
  (type, default, unit), Returns, Raises, Notes (link to the algorithm page), Examples
  (doctest-able). They are the single source of the API reference (quartodoc), of `/help` and
  of `docs/ai/agent.md`.

## Errors and warnings

- Expected errors derive from `OnTheSignalError` (`UnitError`, `TimeRangeError`,
  `ParameterError`, `FileFormatError`, `AnalysisError`): the console shows their message
  without traceback. Messages say what is wrong and how to fix it.
- Data-quality issues are result warnings (`result.warn`), not exceptions.
- Library warnings use `OnTheSignalWarning` (shown in yellow in the console).

## Logging

`logging` only in the core (`logging.getLogger("onthesignal.<module>")`); the acquisition
writes `acquisition.log` in its output folder.

## Versions

Semantic versioning (`src/onthesignal/_version.py`, `pyproject.toml`) and `CHANGELOG.md`
updated with every change.
